subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The Algorithmic Feed
description: Learn The Algorithmic Feed in one minute.

hook.text: You follow 500 people. You only see posts from 50 of them. The algorithm decided which 50.

buildup.text: Algorithmic feeds rank content by predicted engagement — what you're most likely to click, share, or argue about.

discovery.text: Chronological feeds show everything in order. Algorithmic feeds show what maximizes your time on the platform.

twist.text: The algorithm doesn't show you what's true or important. It shows what keeps you scrolling longest.

climax.text: Your feed is curated by a system designed to hold attention — not to inform, connect, or educate.

punchline.text: Not what matters. What makes you scroll.

quiz.question: What does an algorithmic feed prioritize?
options: Content most likely to maximize user engagement and time on platform
The most recent and accurate posts
Posts from your closest friends only
